blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Third Division of the Sandiganbayan said Tuesday that it has junked former Sen. Bong Revilla‘s motion to bar its chairperson, Associate Justice Karl Miranda — the sole judge who denied his bail — from participating in the trial of his malversation case.
